description: Group pool funding (实缴池 = pendingbot.group_pools.total_remaining_pnc_micros, with fairness share_index), member contributions (pendingbot.group_contributions, active rows) and pledges (认缴 = pendingbot.group_pledges.pledge_pnc_micros, active). All amounts PNC = *_pnc_micros / 1e6. The pool balance mirrors Polar (Polar is the balance source of truth). NOTE: group_pools/group_contributions/group_pledges carry member-scoped RLS, so the BI role reads them only through the security-definer aggregate views bi_group_pool_summary / bi_group_pool_detail (migration 20260604044057_bi_aggregate_views) — never the raw member rows.

panels.description: 实缴池: total remaining PNC across all group pools (group_pools.total_remaining_pnc_micros). Mirrors Polar.
panels.title: Group pool remaining balance (实缴池, PNC)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT pool_remaining_micros / 1e6 AS group_pool_remaining_pnc
FROM pendingbot.bi_group_pool_summary;

panels.description: 认缴: sum of active member pledges across all groups (group_pledges.pledge_pnc_micros WHERE status = 'active'). Pledge = the spend cap a member authorises; the money stays in their personal wallet.
panels.title: Active pledges (认缴, PNC)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT active_pledged_micros / 1e6 AS pledged_pnc
FROM pendingbot.bi_group_pool_summary;

panels.description: Active member contributions (实缴): total contributed PNC across all groups (group_contributions WHERE status = 'active'). The funded backing behind the pool balance.
panels.title: Active contributions (实缴, PNC)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT active_contributed_micros / 1e6 AS contributed_pnc
FROM pendingbot.bi_group_pool_summary;

panels.description: Per-group pool: remaining balance + share_index (fairness factor), active contribution count/total, active pledge count/total. Largest pools first. Amounts in PNC.
panels.title: Per-group pool usage

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  subject_id,
  group_name,
  pool_remaining_micros / 1e6 AS remaining_pnc,
  share_index,
  active_contributors,
  contributed_micros / 1e6 AS contributed_pnc,
  active_pledgers,
  pledged_micros / 1e6 AS pledged_pnc,
  updated_at
FROM pendingbot.bi_group_pool_detail
ORDER BY pool_remaining_micros DESC
LIMIT 200;

title: PendingBot — Group Pool & Pledge
